name: picomatch
description: Small glob-to-regex stand-in for @parcel/watcher. It does not compile extglobs, so the repeated-extglob ReDoS in picomatch <= 4.0.7 does not apply. Upstream has no patched release. The file: path in apps/web/package.json is relative to node_modules/@parcel/watcher, which is how npm applies a nested override.
